title: Gemini CLI with 3.1-pro-preview claims its leaked internal thinking is part of user prompt

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue reports unexpected model behavior and output quality issues (internal thinking/comments leaking into output) without providing actionable reproduction code, minimal reproducible steps, or CLI stack traces.
triage_metadata.comment: Hi! Thanks for commenting on this issue, we need more information to triage the bug. Please provide exact, minimal reproduction steps, including prompt input history and any custom configurations or system flags used, so we can isolate whether this issue stems from CLI handling or model responses.
